prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1223; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the scene, I observed two passenger vehicles in the right lane of northbound traffic on a dry, clear roadway in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 stated that the vehicle ahead of them had slowed abruptly for traffic, and Driver 1 was unable to stop in time, resulting in a rear-end collision with Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that they had stopped in the lane and were struck from behind. Damage was consistent with a low-speed impact to the rear of Driver 2's vehicle and the front of Driver 1's vehicle. A Passenger in Driver 2's vehicle was not injured. Driver 2 reported pain in the right shoulder and declined transport by EMS at the scene, though was advised to seek medical evaluation. Both drivers were able to move their vehicles to the shoulder. No citations were issued at the time of the investigation, pending review of statements. Photographs were taken of both vehicles and the roadway.
